prompt: O story `checkout` no epic `sistema-pagamentos` precisa de 3 tasks: `create-order` (sem dependências), `process-payment` (depende de create-order), e `send-receipt` (depende de process-payment). Usando a CLI do Oraculo: (1) registre as 3 tasks com suas dependências; (2) inicie a task `create-order`; (3) complete-a com o sumário 'Order created successfully', sem logs, sem skills_used, com files_modified=['src/order.go']; (4) liste todas as tasks para ver o estado atual. Mostre os comandos e resultados.

assertions.description: Calls `oraculo tools task init` three times for create-order, process-payment, and send-receipt
process-payment has `--depends-on create-order` and send-receipt has `--depends-on process-payment`
Calls `oraculo tools task start create-order --epic sistema-pagamentos --story checkout`
Task complete receives JSON via stdin (not via flags)
The stdin JSON for task complete includes `summary` and `files_modified` fields
Calls `oraculo tools task list --epic sistema-pagamentos --story checkout` at the end
